Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Katakana

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Katakana
public class Katakana extends Object
Katakana-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_KATAKANA section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x04.
